positive_probes: We moved to Danvers, MA last summer.
Her office is in Corning, NY downtown.
They opened a shop near Boulder, CO.
Flights arrived late at Tulsa, OK yesterday.
He was born in Mobile, AL hospital.
distractor_probes: We moved to Danvers, Massachusetts last summer.
Her office is in Corning, New York downtown.
They opened a shop near Boulder CO yesterday.
